# Costs

## Running costs

The AI that drafts the follow-ups costs about 2 cents a draft. At Saltwater's busiest (around 40 quotes a month) that's under a dollar a month.

## What Looked After covers

Running costs, fixes when Gmail or Google changes something, and one small change a month, like a new follow-up example.

## If Kira stops Looked After

The automation keeps running until the end of the month, then we switch it off and hand over the code. The by-hand notes still work.
